---
title: "Theme Analysis"
subtitle: "Frequency, respondent coverage and weighted importance — at theme, sub-theme or code level. Every number links back to its quotations."
---

```{=html}
<div id="tb-no-project-alert" class="alert alert-warning d-none">
<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle"></i> No active project selected. <a href="projects.html">Go to Projects</a> to create or open one.
</div>

<div id="tb-analysis-content" class="d-none">

<div class="card tb-toolbar mb-4">
<div class="card-body">
<div class="tb-toolbar-group"><span class="tb-toolbar-label">Analyse at</span><div id="tb-an-level"></div></div>
<div class="tb-toolbar-group" id="tb-an-within-wrap"><span class="tb-toolbar-label">Within</span>
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" style="width:auto;max-width:18rem;" id="tb-an-within" aria-label="Limit to one theme"></select>
</div>
<div class="small text-muted ms-xl-auto" id="tb-an-note"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="tb-kpi-grid mb-4">
<div class="card tb-kpi"><div class="card-body"><div class="tb-kpi-icon" style="--kpi:#1B4F9C"><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-text"></i></div><div><div class="tb-kpi-value" id="tb-stat-sources">0</div><div class="tb-kpi-label">Sources</div></div></div></div>
<div class="card tb-kpi"><div class="card-body"><div class="tb-kpi-icon" style="--kpi:#2F6FED"><i class="bi bi-people"></i></div><div><div class="tb-kpi-value" id="tb-stat-respondents">0</div><div class="tb-kpi-label">Respondents</div></div></div></div>
<div class="card tb-kpi"><div class="card-body"><div class="tb-kpi-icon" style="--kpi:#E08E45"><i class="bi bi-bookmark-check"></i></div><div><div class="tb-kpi-value" id="tb-stat-codedrefs">0</div><div class="tb-kpi-label">Coded references</div></div></div></div>
<div class="card tb-kpi"><div class="card-body"><div class="tb-kpi-icon" style="--kpi:#17B8A6"><i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i></div><div><div class="tb-kpi-value" id="tb-stat-themes">0</div><div class="tb-kpi-label" id="tb-stat-themes-label">Themes shown</div></div></div></div>
</div>

<div class="grid gap-4 mb-4">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-xl-6">
<div class="card h-100">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header"><span>Frequency <span class="tb-panel-sub">coded references</span></span><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link p-0" data-png="tb-chart-frequency" data-name="theme-frequency" title="Save as PNG"><i class="bi bi-camera"></i></button></div>
<div class="card-body tb-panel-body tb-fill"><div class="tb-chart-box" id="tb-box-frequency"><canvas id="tb-chart-frequency"></canvas></div></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-xl-6">
<div class="card h-100">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header"><span>Weighted score <span class="tb-panel-sub">sum of 1–10 importance scores</span></span><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link p-0" data-png="tb-chart-weighted" data-name="weighted-theme-score" title="Save as PNG"><i class="bi bi-camera"></i></button></div>
<div class="card-body tb-panel-body tb-fill"><div class="tb-chart-box" id="tb-box-weighted"><canvas id="tb-chart-weighted"></canvas></div></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="grid gap-4 mb-4">
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-xl-6">
<div class="card h-100">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header"><span>Respondent coverage <span class="tb-panel-sub">% of respondents raising each theme</span></span><button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-link p-0" data-png="tb-chart-coverage" data-name="respondent-coverage" title="Save as PNG"><i class="bi bi-camera"></i></button></div>
<div class="card-body tb-panel-body tb-fill"><div class="tb-chart-box" id="tb-box-coverage"><canvas id="tb-chart-coverage"></canvas></div></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="g-col-12 g-col-xl-6">
<div class="card h-100">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header"><span>Theme cloud <span class="tb-panel-sub">sized by frequency · click a theme</span></span><a href="wordfrequency.html" class="small fw-semibold text-decoration-none">More options <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></a></div>
<div class="card-body tb-panel-body tb-fill"><div class="tb-cloud-box" id="tb-box-cloud"><canvas id="tb-an-cloud"></canvas></div></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="card mb-4">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header">
<span>Respondent × theme matrix <span class="tb-panel-sub">click any cell for its quotations</span></span>
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" style="width:auto;" id="tb-matrix-metric-select" aria-label="Matrix measure">
<option value="frequency">Frequency</option>
<option value="totalWeight">Total weighted score</option>
<option value="avgWeight">Average weight</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="card-body tb-panel-body" style="overflow-x:auto;">
<table class="table table-sm tb-matrix-table" id="tb-matrix-table"></table>
</div>
</div>

<div class="card mb-4">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header">
<span>Group comparison <span class="tb-panel-sub">the themes above, split by a respondent attribute</span></span>
<div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2">
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" style="width:auto;" id="tb-compare-attribute-select" aria-label="Compare respondents by"></select>
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" style="width:auto;" id="tb-compare-measure" aria-label="Comparison measure">
<option value="coveragePct">Coverage % within group</option>
<option value="frequency">Frequency</option>
</select>
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-body tb-panel-body">
<div class="tb-chart-box tall" id="tb-box-compare"><canvas id="tb-chart-compare"></canvas></div>
<p class="text-muted small mb-0" id="tb-compare-empty"></p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="card mb-4">
<div class="card-header tb-panel-header"><span>Theme hierarchy <span class="tb-panel-sub">every level at once · click a row for quotations</span></span></div>
<div class="card-body p-0">
<div class="table-responsive">
<table class="table table-hover table-sm align-middle tb-hier-table mb-0">
<thead><tr><th class="ps-3">Theme / sub-theme</th><th class="text-end">Frequency</th><th class="text-end">Respondents</th><th class="text-end">Coverage</th><th class="text-end">Total weight</th><th class="text-end pe-3">Avg weight</th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="tb-theme-hierarchy"></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { window.TB.whenReady(function () {
  var TB = window.TB;
  if (TB.seedDemoIfNeeded) TB.seedDemoIfNeeded();
  var project = TB.getActiveProject();
  if (!project) { document.getElementById("tb-no-project-alert").classList.remove("d-none"); return; }
  document.getElementById("tb-analysis-content").classList.remove("d-none");

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s) { return TB.escapeHtml(s); }
  var state = { level: 0, within: "" };
  var LEVEL_NOUN = ["themes", "sub-themes", "codes"];

  function currentItems() { return TB.themeLevelItems(project, state.level, state.within || null); }
  function grouped() { return state.level > 0; }
  function sizeBox(id, n) { $(id).style.minHeight = Math.max(240, n * 26 + 50) + "px"; }

  function renderWithinOptions() {
    var wrap = $("tb-an-within-wrap");
    var options = TB.themesInTreeOrder(project).filter(function (t) { return TB.themeDepth(project, t.id) < state.level; });
    wrap.classList.toggle("d-none", !options.length);
    if (!options.some(function (t) { return t.id === state.within; })) state.within = "";
    $("tb-an-within").innerHTML = '<option value="">All themes</option>' + options.map(function (t) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(t.id) + '"' + (t.id === state.within ? " selected" : "") + ">" + esc(TB.themePath(project, t.id)) + "</option>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderNote() {
    $("tb-an-note").textContent = state.level === 0
      ? "Each theme counts every coded reference under it or its sub-themes, once."
      : "Grouped under their parent theme. One reference coded to two sub-themes counts once for each.";
  }

  function renderSummary(items) {
    $("tb-stat-sources").textContent = project.sources.length;
    $("tb-stat-respondents").textContent = TB.respondentsOf(project).length;
    $("tb-stat-codedrefs").textContent = project.codings.length;
    $("tb-stat-themes").textContent = items.length;
    $("tb-stat-themes-label").textContent = (LEVEL_NOUN[state.level] || "themes").replace(/^./, function (c) { return c.toUpperCase(); }) + " shown";
  }

  function bar(canvasId, boxId, items, key, opts) {
    var list = TB.sortThemeItems(items, key, grouped());
    sizeBox(boxId, list.length);
    TB.charts.barChart(canvasId, list.map(function (i) { return i.label; }), list.map(function (i) { return i.stats[key]; }), Object.assign({
      horizontal: true,
      colors: list.map(function (i) { return i.color; }),
      tooltipTitles: list.map(function (i) { return i.path; }),
      onClick: function (idx) { TB.ui.showThemeEvidence(project, list[idx].id); }
    }, opts));
  }

  function renderCharts(items) {
    bar("tb-chart-frequency", "tb-box-frequency", items, "frequency", { label: "Coded references" });
    bar("tb-chart-weighted", "tb-box-weighted", items, "totalWeight", { label: "Total weighted score" });
    bar("tb-chart-coverage", "tb-box-coverage", items, "coveragePct", { label: "Respondent coverage", suffix: "%", max: 100 });
    renderCloud(items);
  }

  function renderCloud(items) {
    TB.charts.renderThemeCloud("tb-an-cloud", items.map(function (i) {
      return { id: i.id, label: i.label, value: i.stats.frequency, color: i.color };
    }), { onClick: function (item) { TB.ui.showThemeEvidence(project, item.id); } });
  }

  function renderMatrix(items) {
    var metric = $("tb-matrix-metric-select").value;
    var m = TB.matrixData(project, items.map(function (i) { return i.id; }));
    function value(rid, tid) {
      var c = m.cells[rid][tid];
      if (metric === "avgWeight") return c.weightedCount ? Math.round((c.totalWeight / c.weightedCount) * 100) / 100 : null;
      if (metric === "totalWeight") return c.totalWeight;
      return c.frequency;
    }
    var max = 0;
    m.respondents.forEach(function (r) { items.forEach(function (i) { max = Math.max(max, value(r.id, i.id) || 0); }); });

    var html = "<thead>";
    if (grouped()) {
      var runs = [];
      items.forEach(function (i) {
        var last = runs[runs.length - 1];
        if (last && last.topId === i.topId) last.span++;
        else runs.push({ topId: i.topId, span: 1 });
      });
      html += '<tr class="tb-matrix-groups"><th></th>' + runs.map(function (run) {
        var top = TB.themeById(project, run.topId);
        return '<th colspan="' + run.span + '" style="--group-color:' + esc(TB.safeColor(top.color)) + '">' + esc(top.name) + "</th>";
      }).join("") + "</tr>";
    }
    html += "<tr><th>Respondent</th>" + items.map(function (i) {
      return '<th title="' + esc(i.path) + '"><span class="dot" style="background:' + esc(i.color) + '"></span>' + esc(i.theme.name) + "</th>";
    }).join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    html += m.respondents.map(function (r) {
      return '<tr><th class="text-nowrap">' + esc(r.label) + "</th>" + items.map(function (i) {
        var v = value(r.id, i.id);
        return '<td class="tb-cell-heat" style="background:' + TB.charts.heatColor(v || 0, max) + ";color:" + TB.charts.heatTextColor(v || 0, max) +
          ';" data-respondent="' + esc(r.id) + '" data-theme="' + esc(i.id) + '">' + (v === null ? "—" : v) + "</td>";
      }).join("") + "</tr>";
    }).join("");
    html += "</tbody><tfoot><tr><th>Overall</th>" + items.map(function (i) {
      var s = i.stats;
      var v = metric === "avgWeight" ? (s.avgWeight === null ? "—" : s.avgWeight) : metric === "totalWeight" ? s.totalWeight : s.frequency;
      return "<td>" + v + "</td>";
    }).join("") + "</tr><tr><th>Respondents covered</th>" + items.map(function (i) {
      return "<td>" + i.stats.coverageCount + "/" + i.stats.coverageTotal + "</td>";
    }).join("") + "</tr></tfoot>";

    var table = $("tb-matrix-table");
    table.innerHTML = html;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(table.querySelectorAll(".tb-cell-heat"), function (td) {
      td.addEventListener("click", function () {
        TB.ui.showThemeEvidence(project, td.getAttribute("data-theme"), td.getAttribute("data-respondent"));
      });
    });
  }

  var ATTRIBUTE_LABELS = { sex: "Sex", location: "Location", stakeholder: "Stakeholder", institution: "Institution" };
  function comparableAttributes() {
    var respondents = TB.respondentsOf(project);
    return Object.keys(ATTRIBUTE_LABELS).filter(function (key) {
      var values = {};
      respondents.forEach(function (r) { var v = (r.attributes || {})[key]; if (v) values[v] = true; });
      return Object.keys(values).length > 1;
    });
  }

  function renderCompareControls() {
    var attrs = comparableAttributes();
    var select = $("tb-compare-attribute-select");
    if (!attrs.length) {
      select.innerHTML = "";
      select.disabled = true;
      $("tb-compare-empty").textContent = "Add at least two respondents with different Sex, Location, Stakeholder or Institution values to compare groups.";
      return;
    }
    select.innerHTML = attrs.map(function (a) { return '<option value="' + a + '">Compare by ' + ATTRIBUTE_LABELS[a] + "</option>"; }).join("");
  }

  function renderCompare(items) {
    var attrKey = $("tb-compare-attribute-select").value;
    if (!attrKey) { TB.charts.destroy("tb-chart-compare"); return; }
    var measure = $("tb-compare-measure").value;
    var list = items.slice();
    var groupNames = [];
    var perItem = list.map(function (i) {
      var map = {};
      TB.groupComparison(project, attrKey, i.id).forEach(function (g) {
        map[g.value] = g;
        if (groupNames.indexOf(g.value) === -1) groupNames.push(g.value);
      });
      return map;
    });
    groupNames.sort(function (a, b) {
      if (a === "Unspecified") return 1;
      if (b === "Unspecified") return -1;
      return a.localeCompare(b);
    });
    var series = groupNames.map(function (g, gi) {
      return {
        name: g,
        values: perItem.map(function (map) { return map[g] ? map[g][measure] : 0; }),
        color: TB.charts.BRAND_COLORS[gi % TB.charts.BRAND_COLORS.length]
      };
    });
    $("tb-box-compare").style.height = Math.max(300, Math.min(520, 260 + list.length * 6)) + "px";
    TB.charts.groupedBarChart("tb-chart-compare", list.map(function (i) { return i.label; }), series, {
      suffix: measure === "coveragePct" ? "%" : "",
      max: measure === "coveragePct" ? 100 : undefined,
      tooltipTitles: list.map(function (i) { return i.path; })
    });
    $("tb-compare-empty").textContent = measure === "coveragePct"
      ? "Coverage within group = respondents in that group who raised the theme ÷ all respondents in that group, so groups of different sizes compare fairly."
      : "";
  }

  function renderHierarchy() {
    var rows = [];
    (function walk(nodes, depth) {
      nodes.forEach(function (n) { rows.push({ node: n, depth: depth }); walk(n.children, depth + 1); });
    })(TB.themeTree(project), 0);
    var body = $("tb-theme-hierarchy");
    body.innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(function (r) {
      var s = TB.themeStats(project, r.node.id);
      var c = esc(TB.safeColor(r.node.color));
      return '<tr class="depth-' + r.depth + '" data-theme-id="' + esc(r.node.id) + '" style="--depth:' + r.depth + ";--row-color:" + c + '">' +
        '<td class="tb-hier-name ps-3"><span class="dot" style="background:' + c + '"></span>' + esc(r.node.name) + "</td>" +
        '<td class="text-end">' + s.frequency + "</td>" +
        '<td class="text-end">' + s.coverageCount + "/" + s.coverageTotal + "</td>" +
        '<td class="text-end">' + s.coveragePct + "%</td>" +
        '<td class="text-end">' + s.totalWeight + "</td>" +
        '<td class="text-end pe-3">' + (s.avgWeight === null ? "—" : s.avgWeight) + "</td></tr>";
    }).join("") : '<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-muted ps-3">No themes yet — add some from the Coding Workspace.</td></tr>';
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(body.querySelectorAll("tr[data-theme-id]"), function (row) {
      row.addEventListener("click", function () { TB.ui.showThemeEvidence(project, row.getAttribute("data-theme-id")); });
    });
  }

  function renderLevelViews() {
    renderWithinOptions();
    renderNote();
    var items = currentItems();
    renderSummary(items);
    renderCharts(items);
    renderMatrix(items);
    renderCompare(items);
  }

  state.level = TB.ui.levelControl($("tb-an-level"), project, {
    name: "tbAnLevel", value: 0,
    onChange: function (v) { state.level = v; renderLevelViews(); }
  });
  $("tb-an-within").addEventListener("change", function (e) { state.within = e.target.value; renderLevelViews(); });
  $("tb-matrix-metric-select").addEventListener("change", function () { renderMatrix(currentItems()); });
  $("tb-compare-attribute-select").addEventListener("change", function () { renderCompare(currentItems()); });
  $("tb-compare-measure").addEventListener("change", function () { renderCompare(currentItems()); });

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll("[data-png]"), function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      TB.exportUtil.canvasToPNG(btn.getAttribute("data-png"), TB.exportUtil.slug(project.title) + "-" + btn.getAttribute("data-name") + ".png");
    });
  });

  renderCompareControls();
  renderLevelViews();
  renderHierarchy();

  var resizeTimer = null;
  window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () { renderCloud(currentItems()); }, 250);
  });
}); });
</script>
```
